news.title: More Than 1,000 New Billikens Arrive at SLU for Fall 2026
news.summary_en: There were comforters and mini-fridges. Boxes of clothes, desk lamps and family photos. And more than a few cars packed to the roof. More than 1,000 new Billikens arrived at Saint Louis University on Friday, Aug. 14, as first-year students moved into residence halls and began making the SLU campus their new home. But they didn't have to do it alone.

news.title: Leslie Ain McClure to be Honored for Work in Social Justice by Association for Women in Mathematics
news.summary_en: Leslie Ain McClure, Ph.D., will receive the 2027 Mary and Alfie Gray Award for Social Justice from the Association for Women in Mathematics (AWM) at the Joint Mathematics Meetings in Chicago, in January 2027.

news.title: SLU Clinicians Will Offer Free Psychological Services to St. Louis City Residents
news.summary_en: St. Louisans seeking affordable mental health care can take the first step by getting a free assessment at Saint Louis University’s Psychological Services Center. Psychological assessments help determine cognitive, educational, emotional and behavioral difficulties for both children and adults and can result in diagnoses and recommended treatment plans tailored to each individual.
